header.draft: What missed appointments cost a small business, and how to cut them

verdict.summary: Hold: 7 blockers and 7 fixes. A statistic and a quote do not match their sources, one sentence has no source, the Growth plan price is out of date, a commission link has no disclosure, one link lands on the home page, and the byline is a default account.

fix_list.after: Author: [WRITER'S NAME] (the WordPress user of the person who wrote it, with a one-line bio)
fix_list.why: The post's author is the account this connection signs in with, named "admin". Readers would see a default account, not a writer.

fix_list.before: [Industry surveys](https://example-salon-survey.example/2025-appointments-report) put the average salon no-show rate at 23%, so almost one in four bookings never turns up.
fix_list.after: [Industry surveys](https://example-salon-survey.example/2025-appointments-report) put the average salon no-show rate at 12%, and another 11% of bookings are canceled with less than 24 hours' notice, so almost one in four bookings never turns up.
fix_list.why: The source puts no-shows at 12%. The draft's 23% is no-shows plus late cancellations (12 + 11).
fix_list.evidence: Example Salon Survey, published 2025-03-10: "Across 1,140 salons, 12% of booked appointments were no-shows in 2024, and a further 11% were cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice."

fix_list.before: Most clinics lose more than $150,000 a year to no-shows, and the number keeps growing.
fix_list.after: Most clinics lose more than $150,000 a year to no-shows, and the number keeps growing. [ADD SOURCE: link the study behind $150,000 and the growth claim, or cut this sentence]
fix_list.why: Two claims with no source: a money figure for most clinics, and a trend. The skill does not supply a source it has not read.
fix_list.evidence: No link in P3 or the sentences next to it.

fix_list.before: As the practice manager at Quillmoor Physio told us, "Reminders cut our no-shows in half within a month."
fix_list.after: As the practice manager at Quillmoor Physio told us, "After we switched on text reminders, our no-shows dropped by about a third over the first two months."
fix_list.why: The quote does not match the approved call notes: the notes say about a third over two months, not half within a month.
fix_list.evidence: Practice manager, Quillmoor Physio, 2026-10-14, call notes approved by the clinic: "After we switched on text reminders, our no-shows dropped by about a third over the first two months."

fix_list.before: On the Growth plan ($39 a month) you can take deposits at booking with [ExampleBooking payments](https://www.example.com/features/payments/).
fix_list.after: On the Growth plan ($49 a month) you can take deposits at booking with [ExampleBooking payments](https://www.example.com/features/payments/).
fix_list.why: The pricing page says the Growth plan is $49 a month.
fix_list.evidence: Business facts, pricing page as of 2026-10-28: $49 a month.

fix_list.before: If you also want to send marketing texts, we use [Pellbrook SMS](https://pellbrook.example/?ref=examplebooking) ourselves and recommend it.
fix_list.after:
Disclosure: we earn a commission if you sign up for Pellbrook SMS through the link below.

If you also want to send marketing texts, we use [Pellbrook SMS](https://pellbrook.example/?ref=examplebooking) ourselves and recommend it.
fix_list.why: The Pellbrook SMS link carries a referral code and pellbrook.example is on the commission partner list, but the draft has no disclosure. House policy: say so in plain words before the first such link.
fix_list.evidence: https://pellbrook.example/?ref=examplebooking (ref= parameter); disclosure policy: say so in plain words before the first such link.

fix_list.before: Read our [cancellation policy guide](https://www.example.com/blog/cancellation-policy-guide/) for wording you can copy.
fix_list.after: Read our [cancellation policy template](https://www.example.com/templates/cancellation-policy/) for wording you can copy.
fix_list.why: The guide was removed and its URL now redirects to the home page. The site's live page on this topic is https://www.example.com/templates/cancellation-policy/, which earns 109 Search Console clicks in 28 days on "cancellation policy" searches and returns 200.

fix_list.before: [A 2019 study](http://example-physio-study.example/missed-visits-2019) of physiotherapy clinics found that missed appointments cost each clinic $42,000 a year.
fix_list.after: [A 2019 study](http://example-physio-study.example/missed-visits-2019) of physiotherapy clinics found that missed visits cost each clinic an estimated $42,000 in 2018.
fix_list.why: The number matches, but the source is 7.4 years older than the publish date and measured 2018. Say the year, or replace it with a study from the last 3 years if you have one.
fix_list.evidence: Example Physio Study, published 2019-06-01: "The average clinic in our sample lost an estimated $42,000 in revenue to missed visits in 2018."

fix_list.before: [A 2019 study](http://example-physio-study.example/missed-visits-2019) of physiotherapy clinics found that missed appointments cost each clinic $42,000 a year.
fix_list.after: [A 2019 study](https://example-physio-study.example/articles/missed-visits-2019) of physiotherapy clinics found that missed appointments cost each clinic $42,000 a year.
fix_list.why: The link works through a redirect. Link the final URL so the page does not depend on the redirect staying in place.

fix_list.before: Automatic reminders are the simplest fix. Our [reminder feature](https://www.example.com/features/reminders/) sends a text 24 hours and again 2 hours before each visit, and this year we added WhatsApp reminders too.
fix_list.after: Automatic reminders are the simplest fix. Our [reminder feature](https://www.example.com/features/reminders/) sends a text 24 hours and again 2 hours before each visit, and since March 2026 they can go out on WhatsApp too.
fix_list.why: "This year" goes stale in January. The changelog date makes it exact.

fix_list.before: Deposits work too. Clinics that took a deposit at booking saw 40 per cent fewer no-shows, according to [a payments provider's report](https://payments-insights.example/deposits-study).
fix_list.why: The 40% figure could not be checked: the report needs a sign-in. Ask the writer for the report or a copy of the page. Until then it is not verified.
fix_list.evidence: https://payments-insights.example/deposits-study: The page loads (status 200) but the report sits behind a sign-in form, so its text could not be read.

fix_list.before: Deposits work too. Clinics that took a deposit at booking saw 40 per cent fewer no-shows, according to [a payments provider's report](https://payments-insights.example/deposits-study).
fix_list.after: Deposits work too. Clinics that took a deposit at booking saw 40% fewer no-shows, according to [a payments provider's report](https://payments-insights.example/deposits-study).
fix_list.why: Style rule R3: Write percentages with the % sign, not 'per cent' or 'percent'.

fix_list.before: On the Growth plan ($39 a month) you can take deposits at booking with [ExampleBooking payments](https://www.example.com/features/payments/).
fix_list.after: On the Growth plan ($39 a month) you can take deposits at booking with [Example Booking Software payments](https://www.example.com/features/payments/).
fix_list.why: Style rule R1: Write the product name as Example Booking Software, never ExampleBooking.
